lucee.notes: Prior to Lucee 6.2, this function didn't always work as expected

name: FileSetAttribute
description: For the given path, sets the file attributes.

params.name: attribute
params.description:
One of the following:

- readOnly
- normal

On Windows, the following additional attributes are supported (ignored on unix)

- system
- hidden
- archive

Set the attribute to normal to make a file not read-only and not hidden.
